pages.text:
**Storage Sorter.** Moves items that match its filter from one of the machine's storages to another, up to 8 a tick: coke from Green to Purple so an engine burns what the Pyrolyzer made, or ore from Green back to Orange. It never moves anything out of the machine.

**Tag Unifier.** Ingots, nuggets, dusts, plates, gears and gems from different mods become the one your pack prefers: Metallurgy's first, then vanilla's, then Fieldframe's. Set its "preferred" text to change the order for that module ("thermal, minecraft"); items that are not in such a tag pass through unless you switch that off. 20 RF per item.

**Tool Repairer.** Mends damaged tools and armour from **Orange storage** with liquid experience from the **Orange tank**: one point of experience (20 mB) repairs 2 durability, like Mending. Finished items go to **Green storage**. An Experience Collector on the same machine keeps it supplied.

**Mob Grinder.** Attacks up to three mobs in front of it every second with the weapon in **Purple storage**: Sharpness, Looting and Fire Aspect work and the weapon wears. Drops are picked up into **Green storage** and experience into a tank you choose. It never attacks players or tamed animals, and named mobs only when you allow it. 60 RF a swing.
